about:
L&H Branding Irons was founded in 1954 in Mandan, North Dakota, by Anton Helbling, who invented the first electric branding iron. Helbling traveled to farm tradeshows and county fairs, advertising in agricultural publications, and the business grew from that invention.

The company manufactures a complete line of branding irons, including electric, fire-heated, freeze branding, and decorative custom irons. Standard freeze brand sizes range from 1 to 6 inches in height. They also produce custom miniature steak branding irons, boot scrapers, and electric searing irons. The facility maintains a wide inventory of letters, figures, and numerals for standard brands and offers custom design and production for original designs.

L&H serves the livestock and agriculture industries, supplying ranchers and farmers through distributors and direct sales worldwide. Their products also reach food service operations for steak branding and the wedding/event market for decorative custom irons.

The company emphasizes its status as the oldest and largest manufacturer of branding irons in the industry, with national recognition as a leader in electric branding irons. Helbling's original invention addressed a need for efficient livestock identification, and the company continues to focus on custom solutions for unique branding requirements.
